title: Years and genres

rules: Each pair of `release_year` and `primary_genre` appears once, however many films share it.
Sort by `release_year`, newest first, then by `primary_genre` A to Z.

Return only `release_year` and `primary_genre`, in that order.
hints: `distinct` compares whole rows, so pick the two columns before you call it.
`F.desc("release_year")` puts the newest year first; the genre goes after it in `orderBy`.
Sort last: `distinct` doesn't keep any order.
